details: 2fa is awesome and everything should use it but, there should be ways to still recover an account in case of lost access to the auth app.  backups codes   as only backup feels like the '90s are still here.  Discord and twitch have sms as a backup, so does google.   it would not be that hard to implement and would greatly reduce the need of supports tickets for lost accounts. especially if the account is paying towards vrc+.    sms codes could serve as a last resort to recover an account that is lost because let's face it. things happens and you can loose your phone or worst it could break (like mine with a burst battery)  and loose the backup codes because of a failed drive or flash drives because storage is not reliable. it's necessary to keep things painless and loosing an account because of 2fa that gone wrong it's unacceptable even now. people put their heart into making content for vrchat, it's only appreciable to see those efforts not lost because of a tiny mistake or a misfortune.
title: 2fa with sms backup support
